lines.t: Lord, search the secret places of my heart
Show me where I have wandered from Your will
Teach me to turn from every crooked path
Teach me to listen, teach me to be still
When i come before You needing mercy
With open hands, no covering, no pride
Lead me from darkness into truth
And let Your holy light remain inside
When I fall, call me back
When I stray, draw me near
Make my heart sincere before You
Let Your voice be all I hear
Teach me, Lord, to walk in all Your ways
Teach me, Lord, to follow and obey
Wash away the weight of what I’ve done
Make me faithful through Your Holy One
Give me grace to forgive as I’ve been forgiven
Give me love that reflects the heart of You
Teach me, Lord, to walk in all Your ways
Keep me close to you
Forgive the words that came from hurt and fear
Forgive the judgments spoken in my pain
Take every root of bitterness from me
And make my broken heart alive again
For those who wounded me, I choose to pray
For those who turned away, I release…
Let no resentment find a home in me
Replace my anger with Your lasting peace
When I fall, call me back
When I stray, draw me near
Make my heart sincere before You
Let Your voice be all I hear
Teach me, Lord, to walk in all Your ways
Teach me, Lord, to follow and obey
Wash away the weight of what I’ve done
Make me faithful through Your Holy One
Give me grace to forgive as I’ve been forgiven
Give me love that reflects the heart of You
Teach me, Lord, to walk in all Your ways
Keep me close to You
Let my eyes be fixed upon You
Not the failures of my past
Let temptation lose its power
Let Your promise hold me fast
Make me humble, make me willing
Make me true in all I do
Let my life become a witness
Of a heart restored by You
I release them
I forgive them
I will pray and let them go
You have healed me
You have freed me
Now teach me the way to go
Teach me, Lord, to walk in all Your ways
Teach me, Lord, to follow and obey
Keep my heart repentant, clean, and true
Let my every step be led by You
Give me grace to forgive as I’ve been forgiven
Give me love that reflects the heart ofYou
Teach me, Lord, to walk in all Your ways
Keep me close to You
O Lord…
I am Yours…
Teach me…
To walk Your way
